content.value: Water flows at 1.2 m/s past a flat plate with $L = 0 . 9$ m in the flow direction. The boundary layer is tripped, so it becomes turbulent at the leading edge. Evaluate disturbance thickness, displacement thickness, and wall shear stress at the end of the plate. Compare the results with laminar flow maintained at the same position. Assume $v = 1 \times 1 0 ^ { - 6 } \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 } / s$ for water.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2024
